description: Show the battery level of wireless mice, headsets, keyboards and controllers on the Windows 10/11 taskbar. Lightweight tray app, no vendor software needed. Supports Logitech, Razer, SteelSeries, Corsair, HyperX, Glorious, PS4/PS5 DualSense, Xbox and Bluetooth devices.
readme_excerpt:
# Wireless Battery

Battery levels of your wireless mouse, headset, keyboard and controller, right on the Windows taskbar.

![Wireless Battery on the taskbar](docs/screenshot.png)

> **Just want it working?** Download **[WirelessBattery-Setup](https://github.com/krisgfx9/Wireless-Device-Battery-Monitor/releases/latest)** from the latest release, run it and click through. That's it.
>
> **Experienced users** can grab the portable zip, use the [command-line options](#command-line), or [build it from source](#build) with `make` or `build.bat`.

- **Tiny**: a ~350 KB app using about 2 MB of RAM. It's plain C++/Win32, with no runtime and no background service, and installs in seconds without admin rights.
- **No vendor software needed**: it talks to the devices directly. G HUB, Synapse, iCUE, GG and NGenuity can stay closed (or keep running; they don't conflict).
- **Many brands**: Logitech, Razer, SteelSeries, Corsair, HyperX, Glorious, Jabra, JBL, PlayStation and Xbox controllers, Samsung Galaxy Buds, any Bluetooth device Windows knows a battery level for, and every headset the bundled [HeadsetControl](https://github.com/Sapd/HeadsetControl) supports.

## Display

**On the taskbar (default):** `🎧 30%  🖱 93%` next to the notification area, drawn with the Windows icon font.
- **Low battery:** a red number means 15% or less.
- **Charging:** a blue ⚡ appears next to the number.
- **Asleep:** dimmed text means the device is asleep and the last known value is shown.
- **Theme:** it follows light/dark mode and DPI scaling.
- **Transparent taskbar themes** (e.g. Windhawk's Taskbar Styler): turn on *Background behind taskbar text* in the menu to keep the text readable over the wallpaper.

**Tray icons:** one icon per device with the number drawn in it, plus a "Low battery" notification at 15%. The app switches to this automatically when the taskbar is vertical or can't be found.

Hover for details. Click for the menu: every device (click one to hide or show it), display mode, *Refresh now*, *Start with Windows*, and *Exit*. Levels refresh every 60 seconds, and right away when a device is plugged in or the PC wakes up.

## Supported devices

| Vendor | Devices | How |
|---|---|---|
| **Logitech** | Mice and keyboards on Unifying, Bolt, Lightspeed (including the PRO X3 SUPERSTRIKE dongle `046D:C54F`) and Nano receivers, over USB or Bluetooth; G headsets (G533, G535, G633/G635/G733/G933/G935, G PRO/PRO X); G435 on the newer `046D:0ADF` dongle | HID++ 1.0 / 2.0 with feature discovery: unified battery, battery level, voltage, ADC; G435: CRC-16 framed vendor reports, `GET_BATTERY` in mV |
| **Razer** | Wireless mice, keyboards and dongles; BlackShark V2 HyperSpeed, V2 Pro (2023), V3 / V3 Pro / V3 X headsets; Barracuda X (2022) on its 2.4 GHz receiver (`1532:0550`) | Razer feature-report protocol; BlackShark vendor protocols (V3 / V3 Pro / V3 X queried every 5 min); Barracuda X: Airoha battery and cable queries through the receiver |
| **SteelSeries** | Arctis 1/7/7+/9/Pro/Pro Wireless, Arctis Nova 3P/5/7/7X/7P/Pro Wireless, GameBuds; Aerox 3/5/9 Wireless, Prime Wireless, Rival 3 Wireless (Gen 2), Rival 650, Rival Pro | Vendor HID reports |
| **SteelSeries** | Arctis 1/7/7+/9/Pro/Pro Wireless, Arctis Nova 3P/5/7/7X/7P/Pro Wireless (including `1038:225D`), GameBuds; Aerox 3/5/9 Wireless, Prime Wireless, Rival 3 Wireless (Gen 2), Rival 650, Rival Pro | Vendor HID reports |
| **Corsair** | Void / Void Pro / Void Elite / HS70 / HS80 wireless; Bragi devices (Virtuoso, Void V2, HS80 MAX, Slipstream mice and keyboards, including the newer Slipstream receiver `1B1C:2B00`, e.g. Scimitar Elite SE Wireless) | Vendor HID reports, Bragi `GET` (read-only) |
| **Corsair** | Void / Void Pro / Void Elite / HS70 / HS80 wireless; Bragi devices (Virtuoso, Void V2, HS80 MAX, Slipstream mice and keyboards, e.g. Dark Core RGB Pro SE) | Vendor HID reports, Bragi `GET` (read-only) |
| **Cooler Master** | MM712, MM731 (2.4 GHz dongle or USB cable) | Vendor HID status rep

# chat-demo

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A static chat demo powered by the DeepSeek API. No application backend is required: the browser connects directly to the configured API service.

You can [try the app online](https://deepseek-ai.github.io/chat-demo/) or download the archive from [Releases](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-chat-demo/releases), extract it, and double-click `index.html` to use it locally without installation or a build. Enter your API key in Settings before your first chat.

## Getting started

Install Node.js 22.12+ and pnpm, then run:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/chat-demo.git
cd chat-demo
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

Open http://localhost:8090.

To build the static site:

```sh
pnpm build
```

The output is written to `dist/`. Deploy it to a static web server or open `dist/index.html` directly. Opening the file directly requires browser support for storage on `file://` pages and an API service that permits their cross-origin requests.

## Features

- Multiple conversations with automatic titles, renaming, and deletion; edit prompts, regenerate replies, and switch between message branches.
- Streaming replies, deep thinking, smart search, link reading, and source citations; stop generation or continue eligible replies.
- Upload, paste, or drag and drop attachments; use voice input and read replies aloud. A live audio spectrum appears in the first row of the input area while recording on mobile.
- Markdown, syntax highlighting, KaTeX math, and Mermaid diagrams.
- Simplified Chinese and English, light and dark themes, mobile layouts, location settings, and chat history import and export.

## Data and storage

Your API key and settings are stored in the browser's localStorage. Conversations and original attachments are stored in IndexedDB. Local data is isolated by browser profile and site origin. Sending messages, uploading attachments, and using speech features sends the relevant content to the configured API service.

History import and export in Settings use ZIP archives. After confirmation and successful validation, importing replaces all local conversations and attachments. Exports include conversations and locally available original images, but exclude API keys, settings, and original non-image attachments. See the [history import/export documentation (Chinese)](src/services/chat/history/README.md) for the archive format and preservation details.

Settings → Data → Delete all chats clears all local conversations, original attachments, and unsent drafts after confirmation. It stops ongoing replies and returns to a new chat. Your API key and settings are preserved; files already uploaded to the API service are not deleted.

## Development

| Command       | Description                  |
| ------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `pnpm dev`    | Start the development server |
| `pnpm build`  | Build into `dist/`           |
| `pnpm type`   | Run TypeScript type checks   |
| `pnpm lint`   | Lint with oxlint             |
| `pnpm format` | Format with oxfmt            |

[rspack.config.ts](rspack.config.ts) uses `https://api.deepseek.com` by default. Use `createConfig({ apiOrigin, devServer })` to customize the API origin and development server proxy.

Chat uses `deepseek-flash` by default through Anthropic-compatible Messages / Files APIs. Speech features use ASR / TTS endpoints. Requests include extensions for search, link reading, titles, and `latest_reminder`, so the configured service must support the corresponding capabilities. Supported attachment formats are determined by server-side validation.

```text
src/
  app/                 Application layout, themes, and global styles
  components/          Chat, settings, Markdown, and other UI components
  i18n/                English and Chinese translations
  services/
    api/               API requests, SSE, and protocol types
    chat/              Conversations, message branches, storage, and history import/

description: A dreamy underwater world you can swim through in your browser: swaying kelp forests, sunbeams, a sunken ship and manta rays. Everything is generated by code with WebGPU (no images, models or sound files), all in a single 97 KB HTML file.
readme_excerpt:
# Abyssal Garden

**A dreamy underwater world you can swim through, right in your browser.**

Towering kelp forests, sunbeams pouring through a rippling surface, a sunken ship, manta rays gliding overhead.
And all of it is made by code: no images, no 3D models, no sound files. The whole world fits in **one 96 KB HTML file**.

![Kelp forest with a stone whale tail and a manta ray](.github/screenshots/whale-fluke.jpg)

## Try it

1. Download [`index.html`](index.html).
2. Open it in **Chrome** or **Edge** on a desktop computer.
3. Wait a few seconds while the world is built, then press **Dive in** and start swimming.

Nothing to install, and it works offline. It needs a browser with **WebGPU**. If you see *"This scene needs WebGPU"*, update your browser or switch to Chrome / Edge.

## What's down there

- **Kelp forests** that sway in the current and sparkle with tiny gold and green specks
- **Light rays** streaming down from a wavy surface, with shimmering caustics on the sea floor
- **A sunken wooden ship**, a **giant stone whale tail**, rock arches, canyons and floating boulders
- **Manta rays**, schools of fish, rising bubbles and drifting particles
- **A purple grotto** with glowing magenta ground cover, coral and barrel sponges
- **A soundscape** made up as you listen: a deep rumble, distant whale calls, soft chimes and bubbles

| | |
|---|---|
| ![Shipwreck](.github/screenshots/shipwreck.jpg) | ![Looking up through the kelp](.github/screenshots/kelp-forest.jpg) |
| ![Barrel sponges](.github/screenshots/sponge-garden.jpg) | ![Light rays over the kelp basin](.github/screenshots/light-rays.jpg) |

![The purple grotto](.github/screenshots/purple-grotto.jpg)

## Controls

| | Keyboard & mouse |
|---|---|
| Look around | Move the mouse |
| Swim | `W` `A` `S` `D` |
| Up / down | `E` / `Q` |
| Swim faster | Hold `Shift` |
| Jump to a viewpoint | `1` to `6` (the spots in the screenshots) |
| Menu | `Esc` releases the mouse and opens the menu with the list of controls; **Resume** takes you back |
| Sound on / off | `M` (sound starts when you dive in) |
| Performance stats | `H` |
| Detail level | **Low**, **Medium** or **High** in the menu (reloads the page) |

The seabed, cliffs and arches are solid: you glide along the rock instead of swimming into it, and you still fit through every tunnel and arch. Kelp, plants, corals, sponges, loose rocks, the floating boulders, the ship and the whale tail you can swim through.

**On a touchscreen:** hold one finger down to swim forward and slide it to steer. Put a second finger down to go faster. The `≡` button in the corner opens the menu. Phones always show the scene in landscape and start on Low or Medium detail. (Touch support is experimental.)

## Detail levels

The **Low**, **Medium** and **High** buttons in the menu pick the detail level; the current one is lit. Each level is the same world, built with less in it:

| Level | What it is | Picked on a first visit for |
|---|---|---|
| **High** | The full scene | Computers |
| **Medium** | Half of the leaves, sparkles and pebbles; small rocks, sponges and corals cast no shadows | Phones with 8 GB of memory |
| **Low** | A quarter of the leaves, no anti-aliasing, coarser rocks and corals, simpler lighting, 480p to start with | Other phones, and computers with 4 GB of memory or less |

If loading crashes the tab, or the graphics driver gives up, the page starts again one level lower. Your browser remembers the level, and the resolution and draw distance the scene settled on, for the next visit.

## How it works

- The seabed is sculpted on your graphics card every time the page opens, then decorated with about two million kelp leaves and plants, tens of thousands of rocks, and thousands of sponges, corals and fish.
- Everything is drawn with **WebGPU** directly. No game engine or 3D library is used.
- The ship, whale tail, mantas, fish and corals are built from simple mathematical shapes.
- The sound is synthesized live with the Web Audio

description: muse.ai 注册与邀请码兑换协议研究（纯 HTTP Python 实现）
readme_excerpt:
# muse.ai 注册 / 邀请码兑换 协议分析

补充一下，记得用JP 节点， JP 不需要绑卡，直接过

纯 HTTP 实现 muse.ai 的注册与邀请码兑换流程，不依赖浏览器。本文记录的是通过抓包逐字段比对得出的协议细节。

## 快速开始

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp config.example.json config.json   # 填入邮箱与可选代理
python example_register.py
```

## 目录结构

```
musepy/
  client.py    注册 + 兑换的完整协议客户端
  runner.py    多账号批量调度（sticky 代理 / 预算 / 停止语义）
  otp.py       验证码轮询（幂等：只取 send 之后的最新码）
  falco.py     行为埋点上报（可选）
  caa.py       注册漏斗事件上报（可选）
example_register.py        单账号端到端示例
example_batch.py           多账号批量示例
config.example.json        配置模板
test_onboarding_smoke.py   离线冒烟（披露解析纯函数）
test_runner_smoke.py       离线冒烟（批量调度，mock 网络）
```

## 协议流程

```
GET  /                                   拿初始 cookie
POST /api/auth/native/restart            → 201 {csrf_token}
POST /api/auth/native/send-otp           → 201
POST /api/auth/native/confirm-otp        → 200 {registration_state:"completion_required",
                                               tos:{content_version}}（动态 TOS 版本）
POST /api/auth/native/register-completion→ 200 {auth_meta_session:{frl_access_token, frl_account_id}}
POST auth.meta.com/hatch/session/bootstrap/ → 302…→ muse.ai 200 HTML（会话引导，必须）
     └ 从 muse.ai 文档解析动态披露 disclosure_text/disclosure_version 与状态门
       （resolvedDestination/isGeoGated/waitlist → 地区受限）
POST /api/hatch/accept-tos               → 200（单次调用；正文用服务端动态披露，非硬编码）
GET  /api/hatch/invite                   → 200 表示账号有效
POST /api/hatch/vm/wake                  → 200（必须，否则兑换误报 invalid；
                                             wake_trigger=mount + open_id + away_ms=0）
POST /api/hatch/stateful-sharing         → 200
POST /api/hatch/invite-code/redeem       → 200 {redemptionStatus:"redeemed"}
POST /api/hatch/invite                   → 200 {code}（取回自己的码，不等于页面刮开 reveal）
```

## 几个容易踩的坑

### 1. `confirm-otp` 必须带 `supports_muse_link_transparency: true`

```json
{"otp_code":"123456","remember_device":true,"supports_muse_link_transparency":true}
```

### 2. `register-completion` 的姓名字段语义

```json
{
  "date_of_birth": "1993-11-14",
  "first_name": "三郎",     // 名（given name）
  "last_name": "近藤",      // 姓（family name）
  "tos_content_version": "ntm_create_account:default_v1_meta_account_v3+docs_v2",
  "remember_device": true
}
```

`first_name` 是名、`last_name` 是姓，与直觉相反。生日早于约 18 年前会返回 403——同一会话同一份姓名，只把生日从 2013 改成 1993 就能从 403 变 200。

### 3. `restart` 的 body 不是空对象

```json
{"resume": false}
```

### 4. `accept-tos` 是会话激活开关，且必须先引导会话

注册完成后**必须先走 `POST auth.meta.com/hatch/session/bootstrap/`**（form 表单只带
`frl_access_token`，手动跟随 302/301/303 跳转落到 muse.ai 200 文档），否则后续
hatch 接口一律 403。引导落地的 muse.ai 文档里带有 Next Flight 序列化的动态披露
（`disclosureText` / `disclosureVersion`，当前实测版本为 `HATCH_ROW_v0`），`accept-tos`
的正文必须用服务端返回的这份动态文案（**不是**硬编码常量），`Referer` 用披露页
URL；单次调用即可，不重试，403 时把响应体前 200 字符带出来便于诊断。

引导后若服务端判定 `resolvedDestination == "waitlist"` 或 `isGeoGated == true`，
属于**地区受限**：注册已完成、账号保留，但未证明已加入名单。

### 5. `vm/wake` 缺失会让兑换误报

不调 `vm/wake` 直接兑换，即使是有效码也会返回：

```json
{"success":false,"reason":"invalid","detail":"この招待コードは存在しません"}
```

需要先从已登录页面提取 `vmId`：

```python
re.search(r'vmId[\\"]*:[\\"]*([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})', html)
```

`wake` 的 body 实测为：`wake_trigger: "mount"`（首连）、`open_id`（新 uuid）、
`away_ms: 0`，而不是早期的 `resume`。

### 6. 兑换失败原因的含义

| reason | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `redeemed` | 成功 |
| `already_redeemed` | 本账号已经兑换过一个码 |
| `used_up` | 该码达到 30 次使用上限 |
| `invalid` | 码不存在，或没调 `vm/wake` |

## Cookie

注册成功后 `hatch_sess` 由 `register-completion` 的响应头下发（约 886 字符），这是后续所有 hatch 接口的凭证。`hatch_vml` 在注册阶段一直是被清空状态（`Max-Age=0`），不属于必需项。

## 多账号批量（musepy/runner.py）

```bash
python example_batch.py [count]
```

`config.json` 里的批量字段：

| 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `otp_file` | 邮箱清单，每行 `email----otp源URL`（otp 源返回 `[{"otp","time"},...]` JSON） |
| `proxy_file` | sticky 代理池，每行 `host:port:user:pass`（或 `host:port`） |
| `codes_file` | 可选，待兑换邀请码池，每行一个 |
| `output_dir` / `tried_file` | 每账号结果 JSON 目录 / 已尝试邮箱清单 |
| `workers` / `max_per_ip` | worker 数（默认 5）/ 每条代理的验证成功上限（默认 6） |
| `resolve_ip` | 是否通过 ipify 解析出口 IP（默认 true） |
| `send_caa` | 批量模式

description: 基于 Shizuku 免 Root 清除国产安卓 SystemHelper、RegService 等系统预装隐私数据收集模块
readme_excerpt:
# 遥测清理 · TelemetryCleaner > 运营商为终端入网、自注册、网络运维和故障排查，确有在相应场景收集必要数据的实际需求！本项目仅供学习，用于了解 Android 系统包管理机制。 TelemetryCleaner 可以检测国行 Android 固件预置的运营商组件，查看各空间的安装状态和权限，并管理卸载与恢复。下载： [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Eynnzerr/TelemetryCleaner/releases/latest)

您可通过不限于以下方式参与贡献，欢迎 PR： 1. 提供清单未覆盖的厂商+运营商+包名线索，在 README.md 中补充即可； 2. 提供针对某模块的实测与分析报告，不限制是否为 AI 生成，但需保证真实性。放于 docs 目录中即可； 3. ~协助实现未支持的免 Root 卸载功能（如**现版本不支持部分 vivo 系的电信/移动组件卸载**）~； 4. 对软件功能的反馈或改进。 ## 背景介绍 部分国产厂商在国行固件中预置了 `SystemHelper`、`RegService` 等运营商终端管理组件。这些组件在后台静默定时采集数据，用户无感；没有桌面入口，同时无法以常规手段禁用权限和卸载。 WiSec 2023 的流量测量还在部分国行样机上观察到运营商组件上报数据，其中小米及 ColorOS 样本的中国移动组件上报了已安装软件列表。 [WiSec 2023 实测论文](https://www.scss.tcd.ie/Doug.Leith/pubs/wisecfp034-liu.pdf#page=7) 在作者本人的 OPPO 真机上观测到 SystemHelper 有读取定位、设备和 SIM 标识、已安装应用以及按应用统计网络流量，随后向某云端上传的行为，分析详见 [SystemHelper 代码与权限分析 by AI](docs/reports/oppo-telemetry-components.md)。 ## 本项目原理 Android 10 及以上设备可安装本项目。默认使用 Shizuku，已获取 Root 的设备可在首页选择「使用 Root」，也可在设置里切换权限来源。扫描后可选择空间、查看组件权限或批量操作。 - **Shizuku** · 按 [Shizuku 启动指南](https://shizuku.rikka.app/guide/setup/)通过 ADB 或无线调试启动服务，再回到 App 授权。Android 11 及以上支持无线调试启动。 - **Root** · 在 Root 管理器里授权 Telemetry Cleaner，回到首页连接 Root。扫描、卸载、恢复和自动清理通过 Root 会话执行，无需安装 Shizuku。 ADB 启动的 Shizuku 以 shell 身份代理 Binder 调用。App 直接请求系统包管理服务，避开部分 ROM 对 `pm` 命令行入口的拦截。系统包管理服务仍会执行本机的权限和包状态校验。 [Binder 调用实现](app/src/main/java/com/eynnzerr/telemetrycleaner/data/PackageBinder.kt) 少数 ROM 会在命令层拒绝卸载系统应用，例如返回 `Failure [only root can delete system app for a particular user]`。Shizuku 模式可通过 `app_process` 调用 `IPackageManager.deletePackageAsUser` 再试一次。App 回读包状态确认结果，失败时结果页保留原始系统错误。 [app_process 兜底实现](app/src/main/java/com/eynnzerr/telemetrycleaner/data/PackageFallback.kt) 卸载按选定空间执行，会清除该空间中的组件数据。恢复使用系统保留的 APK。自动清理默认关闭，开启后按配置的周期检查所选空间，只处理自动清理名单内的组件。使用 Root 时，设备重启或 App 进程退出后，需在首页重新连接 Root 才会继续自动清理。 **已知限制：vivo OriginOS 的 PMS 底层中，电信/移动组件 com.vivo.devicereg 被列入了 vivo 系统保护名单，暂无法在非 Root 情况下完成卸载。其他厂商经实测反馈均支持。** ## 内置组件清单 表中的「未验证」指尚无本人在相应厂商设备上的卸载验证。 | 厂商 | 运营商 | 包名 | 卸载验证 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 跨厂商 | 联通 | `com.mobiletools.systemhelper` | 已实测 | | OPPO / 一加 / realme | 电信 | `com.oppo.ctautoregist` | 已实测 | | OPPO / 一加 / realme | 移动 | `com.coloros.regservice` | 已实测 | | 小米 / Redmi / POCO | 电信 | `com.xiaomi.registration` | 已实测 | | 小米 / Redmi / POCO | 移动 | `com.miui.dmregservice` | 已实测 | | vivo | 移动 / 电信 | `com.vivo.devicereg` | 暂不支持 | | 华为及旧荣耀 | 电信（数据） | `com.huawei.android.UEInfoCheck` | 已实测 | | 华为及旧荣耀 | 电信（短信） | `com.huawei.android.AutoRegSms` | 已实测 | | 华为 | 移动 | `com.huawei.regservice` | 已实测 | | 荣耀 | 电信（数据） | `com.hihonor.android.UEInfoCheck` | 已实测 | | 荣耀 | 电信（短信） | `com.hihonor.android.AutoRegSms` | 已实测 | | 荣耀 | 移动 | `com.hihonor.regservice` | 已实测 | | 魅族 / Flyme | 移动 | `com.meizu.regservice` | 已实测 | | 初代红魔 | 电信 | `cn.nubia.register` | 未验证 | 本人只验证了 SystemHelper 和 OPPO 组件的卸载，小米、华为由网友验证实测。其他厂商因缺少设备暂未验证，如决定卸载，请自行承担风险。 欢迎在 [Issues](https://github.com/Eynnzerr/TelemetryCleaner/issues) 反馈某厂商某模块卸载后使用正常，也欢迎补充组件。附上机型、系统版本、包名和实际结果，便于复核。 ## WIP - [ ] 努比亚、国行三星、魅族运营商遥测组件包名收集 - [ ] 扩充更多组件检测（包括厂商自己的敏感数据收集组件）作为可选项 - [x] 部分 vivo 系不支持卸载 SystemHelper 外的组件。暂提供冻结策略作为兜底

readme_excerpt:
资源雷达 · Resource Radar

全网福利、黑五好价、拼车交易、开源项目与新闻资讯的多兴趣自托管聚合雷达站

六大内容形态分流 · 27 类分频道目录 · 统一屏蔽词省额度 · AI 语义定级 · 多路由精准推送

简体中文 · English

--- **资源雷达（Resource Radar / repo: `freebie-radar`）** 是一款轻量、开箱即用的多兴趣社区信息聚合与精准推送工作台。它从各大开发者社区、游戏平台、软件限免站、GitHub、Reddit、Bluesky、Telegram 频道及自定义 RSS 采集信息，并通过 **「规则初筛与统一屏蔽 → AI 语义定级与分流 → 分频道目录呈现 → 多路由精准推送」** 把每条内容送到它该去的位置： - 只想纯粹蹲羊毛？首页默认 **「真福利精选」** 严格锁定 AI 验真的 `freebie`（直接白嫖 + 实操可领的有条件福利），绝不被付费好价、拼车、二手或新闻污染。 - 想看 **黑五 VPS 好价 / 合规拼车 / 开源项目 / 重大新闻与科技资讯**？一键切换顶部兴趣频道即可浏览各自专属的下级分类、真实有效计数与图文卡片，并可分别配置互不干扰的 Telegram 专题推送路由。 --- > 在线演示： --- ## 界面预览 | 工作台列表视图（多兴趣频道栏 + 跨源折叠 + 兑换码一键复制） | 三列图文卡片视图（零额外请求封面图提取 + 响应式 2列/3列网格） | | :---: | :---: | | ![工作台列表视图](docs/ui-public.png) | ![三列图文卡片视图](docs/ui-grid.png) | | 多路由精准推送（分形态/分类/获取方式/关键词定制即时或攒批路由） | AI 语义引擎（27 类分流、自适应学习与零 Token 存量重整分类） | | :---: | :---: | | ![多路由精准推送](docs/ui-push-panel.png) | ![AI 语义引擎](docs/ui-ai-panel.png) | --- ## 核心特性 ### 1. 多兴趣频道与「形态 × 领域 × 获取方式」正交分类 - **6 大内容形态（`kind`）**：`freebie`（白嫖福利）、`deal`（特价好价·含黑五 VPS/拼车/二手出鸡）、`opensource`（开源项目）、`news`（重要新闻）、`info`（行业资讯·指南）、`noise`（纯求助/灌水噪音）。 - **27 个垂直领域（`category`）**：覆盖 `ai`（AI 额度）、`vps`（VPS/主机）、`cloud`（云服务）、`domain`（域名/建站）、`opensource`（开源软件）、`software`（软件授权）、`dev`（开发/工程）、`design`（设计/素材）、`security`（安全/网络）、`hardware`（硬件/数码）、`media`（影音会员）、`game`（游戏）、`carpool`（拼车/合租）、`trade`（二手/交易）、`headline`（时政要闻）、`world`（国际要闻）、`finance`（经济/商业）、`stock`（股票/市场）、`tech`（科技动态）、`news`（综合资讯）、`goods`（实物/优惠）、`offline`（实物福利）、`invite`（邀请码）、`edu`（教育/考试）、`pan`（网盘资源）、`course`（网课/教程）、`other`（其它）。 - **8 个兴趣频道与自适应下级分类**：真福利、全部白嫖、实物福利、网盘/网课、好价、开源、重要新闻、行业资讯； - 「真福利 / 全部白嫖」只展现福利类目（隐藏拼车/交易/新闻要闻，网盘/网课/实物福利各自独立成频道），统计数字实时排除 `noise` 假数； - 「重要新闻 / 行业资讯」自动切换为资讯栏目视角（时政要闻、国际要闻、经济/商业、股票/市场、科技前沿、AI 前沿、开发工程、开源生态、安全/漏洞、硬件数码、综合资讯）； - 切换频道自动重置不兼容的形态、获取方式与价格上限，避免空屏串态。 - **6 级获取方式（`obtain`）**：严格区分 `free`（直接白嫖）、`conditional`（有条件）、`lottery`（抽奖）、`trial`（试用/Demo）、`promo`（推广/引流）、`paid`（需付费）。 ### 2. 三层高信噪比治理（统一屏蔽 · AI 定级 · 零 Token 重整） - **统一屏蔽词防火墙（省额度 + 隐网页 + 拦推送）**：在「订阅与屏蔽」配置关键词、正则或分源规则，不仅隐藏网页条目、拦截推送与日报，**在采集入库送 AI 审核及历史补审前也会直接跳过**，无需在两处重复配置。 - **AI 语义审核引擎**：支持任意 OpenAI 兼容接口，单次输出 `keep`、`kind`、`category`、`obtain`、`quality`（1–5 星）与中文理由；支持白嫖专源免审直通、追加补充规则、从收藏/关闭自动学习个人偏好。 - **零 Token 存量分类重整**：内置「重整分类 (0 Token)」入口与 CLI，更新关键词规则后可一键将历史 `other` 条目零成本归位到细分类目。 ### 3. 三种响应式视图与零请求封面图提取 - **单行紧凑 / 2列卡片 / 3列卡片** 一键切换并记住偏好。 - 14 路采集器（Epic / Steam / GamerPower / CheapShark / GOG / RSS `` & `` / Telegram / LINUX DO / V2EX / B站 / 微博 / CCTV / Bluesky / 本地回环）零额外请求提取封面图，纯文本条目自动收起封面区避免网格空洞。 ### 4. 多路由精准 Telegram 推送 - **全局策略 + 多专题路由**：支持一键新增或可视化编辑独立路由（例如：「🎁 真福利直推」「🖥 黑五/VPS 即时提醒」「📦 开源项目攒批汇总」「📰 新闻资讯早报」），每条路由可单独设定形态、分类、获取方式、关键词、最高价、最低分、即时/攒批模式与自定义前缀头。 - **推送时机与兜底**：支持「推送前先过 AI（防误推）」与「极速抢码先推后审（后台补审后自动补推）」；提供 `strict` / `rule_fallback` / `ignore_ai` 三种 AI 兜底模式。 - **防误推二次校验与诊断预览**：攒批发送前二次回查 DB 状态与最新屏蔽词；支持查看拦截原因分布与路由命中预览；内置夜间静默时段与多语言/时效闸门。 ### 5. 极简部署与单密码鉴权分区 - **零外部数据库**：基于 `node:24-alpine` 原生运行 TypeScript，内置 `node:sqlite`（WAL 模式 + 内存上限调优，自动增量迁移至 Schema v30），日常运行内存 < 100MB。 - **111 个内置数据源（默认精选启用 62 个）**：覆盖 LINUX DO、NodeSeek（含福利/资讯/拼车交易板块）、V2EX、NGA（优惠/拼车/二手）、B站、微博、CCTV 新闻、OpenRouter `:free` 模型、GitHub、Epic、Steam、GamerPower、CheapShark、ITAD、SharewareOnSale、Tick

description: Allo is your friendly neighborhood typeface, free and open source

# Allo Allo is your friendly neighborhood typeface. It’s variable in weight and roundness, with proportions and curves designed to feel warm without being too cute and clear without being too cold. It’s a perfect companion out of the box, and three variable axes and plenty of alternates let you tune its personality to exactly what you need. Allo is optimized for screens and interfaces, with an optical size that adjusts automatically between text and display. And it’s packed with big little details: tabular figures, fractions, punctuation that lifts beside capitals, arrows that appear when you type them, a host of alternates and symbols, as well as a true oblique in every weight. ### [Type specimen at allo.joshpuckett.me →](https://allo.joshpuckett.me)
![Allo: the typeface, and its character set](documentation/readme-row1.png) ![Allo: OpenType features, and interface icons and symbols](documentation/readme-row2.png) ## Download Get `Allo-1.0.1.zip` from the [latest release](https://github.com/joshpuckett/allo/releases/latest): | Folder | Contents | |---|---| | `fonts/otf` | 18 static fonts, Thin to Black, each with an Oblique | | `fonts/variable` | `AlloVariable.ttf`: all optical sizes, weights and roundnesses | | `fonts/webfonts` | The same fonts as WOFF2, plus `AlloVariableFriendly.woff2` (roundness fixed at 50, about half the size) | The static and variable fonts are separate families, **Allo** and **Allo Variable**, so both can be installed. ## Web From npm: ```sh npm install allo-font ``` ```js import "allo-font"; // the full variable font, and the obliques // import "allo-font/friendly"; // or: roundness fixed at 50, about half the size ``` ```css body { font-family: "Allo", system-ui, sans-serif; } ``` Or host the files yourself, from `fonts/webfonts`: ```css @font-face { font-family: "Allo"; src: url("AlloVariable.woff2") format("woff2"); font-weight: 100 900; font-style: normal; font-display: swap; } body { font-family: "Allo", system-ui, sans-serif; } ``` - **Optical size** follows the font size (`font-optical-sizing: auto`, the CSS default). Set it to `none` to keep the Text design at every size, or pick one with `font-variation-settings: "opsz" 32`. - **Roundness** has no CSS property: use `font-variation-settings: "ROND" 0` (sharp) to `"ROND" 100` (round). Default 50. - **Smaller file:** `AlloVariableFriendly.woff2` has roundness fixed at 50; `"ROND"` has no effect. Its family name is "Allo Variable Friendly". - **Obliques:** the npm CSS includes them. Self-hosting, add an `@font-face` with `font-style: italic` and the matching `font-weight` for each oblique WOFF2 you use (`Allo-Oblique.woff2`, `Allo-BoldOblique.woff2`, …). ## Axes | Axis | Tag | Range | Default | Named values | |---|---|---|---|---| | Optical size | `opsz` | 9–32 | 14 | 9 Small, 14 Text, 32 Display | | Weight | `wght` | 100–900 | 400 | Thin 100 to Black 900 | | Roundness | `ROND` | 0–100 | 50 | 0 Sharp, 50 Friendly, 100 Round | Display (32) is tighter, with stronger optical corrections. Below 14 only the spacing changes. The static fonts are the variable font at opsz 14, ROND 50. ## OpenType features | Feature | Effect | |---|---| | `ss01` Single-story a | ɑ-shaped a | | `ss02` Disambiguation | Serifed I, tailed l, footed 1, slashed zero | | `ss03` Open figures | Open 4, 6 and 9 | | `cv01`–`cv04` | Footed 1, slashed zero, tailed l, serifed I, separately | | `cv05` | Dotted zero | | `tnum` | Tabular figures | | `zero` | Slashed zero | | `frac` | Fractions: 1/2 → ½ | | `sups`, `subs`, `numr`, `dnom` | Superscript, subscript, numerator, denominator | | `case` | Punctuation and symbols raised for capitals | | `liga` | tt, ff, tf, ft with a shared crossbar | | `calt` | `->` → →; brackets, signs, ¿ and ¡ raised beside capitals and figures | Browsers turn ligatures off when letter-spacing is set. For code, use `font-variant-ligatures: no-contextual`. ## Build Python 3.9 or newer: ```sh pyth

# ai-texture-forge

**An AI-powered texture forge for Blender — turn text prompts into seamless PBR materials, concept art and scene-wide projections with local or cloud diffusion models, straight inside the 3D viewport on Windows.**

[download-url]: https://github.com/linknimiball1974/ai-texture-forge/releases

![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.11-3776AB) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows-0078D6) ![Blender](https://img.shields.io/badge/Blender-4.2%2B-E87D0D) ![Stable Diffusion](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI-Stable%20Diffusion-8A2BE2) ![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-active-2EA44F)

[![Download](docs/download-button.svg)][download-url]

**The forge in one scene:** type `weathered copper, green patina, seamless` in the N-panel, pick a provider, and a tile-ready PBR set lands on the active object — color, roughness and normal maps wired in one click; one depth-aware projection later, the whole alley is skinned before the coffee cools.

## Why

Texturing from stock libraries is a grind: hours hunting for a texture that only sort of fits, seams stitched by hand in an image editor, round-trips through external AI tools that break your flow, and licenses that never quite cover the project. ai-texture-forge moves generation into the 3D viewport — you describe the surface, the forge renders it with a local GPU engine or a connected cloud provider, bakes seamless tiling, projects it across the scene by depth and wires the maps into Blender's shader nodes — so a project travels from blockout to fully textured render in one sitting without leaving Blender.

## Without / With

| Without | With |
|---|---|
| Hunting stock libraries for a texture that sort of fits | Type the surface you want and generate it on the spot |
| Seams stitched by hand in an image editor | The Seamless option bakes perfect tiling into every generation |
| Round-tripping through external AI tools and re-importing images | Generation runs inside the viewport and lands straight on the object |
| Skinning a whole scene object by object | One depth-aware projection textures the entire scene in a pass |
| Low-res outputs that fall apart in close-ups | AI upscaling lifts generations 4× with the detail intact |

## Quick Start

1. Download **`mcp-for-blender-pro.zip`** from [Releases](../../releases/latest).
2. In Blender, open **Edit → Preferences → Get Extensions → menu → Install from Disk**.
3. Select the ZIP, enable **mcp-for-blender-pro**, then open **3D Viewport → N → MCP Pro**.
4. Choose a provider, add your connection details and select a model.
5. Send a message in Blender or click **Open Studio Window**.

## Features

- **Generate from a text prompt** — textures, concept art and background assets from a plain description, with prompt presets that get the look right on the first try.
- **Bake seamless tiling** — the Seamless option produces textures that tile with no visible seam, ready for game and archviz surfaces.
- **Skin entire scenes by projection** — depth-to-image paints whole models and environments in a single pass.
- **Fix and extend with inpaint/outpaint** — repair blemishes and seams, or grow an image in any direction to widen a backdrop.
- **Upscale 4× with AI** — low-res generations come back crisp enough for close-ups.
- **Restyle renders** — the render pass and node system re-style stills and animations inside the compositor.
- **Choose your engine** — run diffusion locally on your GPU or connect a cloud provider, and keep every result in a history you can recall, export and import.

## How it works

ai-texture-forge runs as a single Blender add-on: the **N-panel** and **Studio Window** route your prompt to the **Provider Layer**, which drives a local **Diffusion Engine** on your GPU or a connected cloud API, while the **Texture Pipeline** handles seamless wrapping, depth projection, inpainting and 4× upscaling and the **Material Builder

readme_excerpt:
# inference-optimisation An agent skill for **hill-climbing the speed of a local LLM server** on any hardware and any quantization. It covers: - single-user and concurrent decode - speculative decoding - prefill - KV cache size - startup time and time to first token It works under a memory cap, and every result has to survive a full-context stability check. It encodes how we actually got these speedups. It is not a list of flags. The workflow: 1. Compute the theoretical ceiling. 2. Change one thing at a time. 3. Measure against interleaved controls. 4. Log every result, including the failures. 5. Gate on long-context retrieval. 6. Qualify a clean, pinned build before publishing. It works with Claude Code and any agent that loads `SKILL.md`-style skills. Any model can also follow it from [`PROMPT.md`](PROMPT.md). ## What we've been able to accomplish Results from the hill-climbs this skill was distilled from. Every number was measured on the hardware named; see the linked sources for methods and raw data. | Hardware | Model / quant / engine | Before → after | |---|---|---| | **Intel Arc B390 iGPU** (laptop, 64 GB unified LPDDR5X, ~115 GB/s) | Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B, EXL3 4 bpw, SGLang XPU + MTP | Decode, 1 user: 43.6 → **53 tok/s** (median)
Decode, 4 users: 84.7 → **103 tok/s**
Prefill 32K: 1,037 → **1,660 tok/s**
Prefill 256K: 297 → **628 tok/s** (2.1×)
KV cache: 264K tokens → **4 × 256K**
Startup: 113 → **43 s**
Registry Lab gates: decode 28.6 → **41.0**, prefill 255 → **667** | | **Intel Arc Pro B70** | Qwen3.8-27B, EXL3 4 bpw, vLLM + custom XPU kernels | Decode: **91.2 tok/s** at 1 user, **365** at 16 (prose, thinking on)
Same card with llama.cpp Q4_K_M: 25.0
Prefill 4K/32K/128K/254K: 1,654/1,434/928/650 → **2,421/2,259/1,415/911**
Agent-session replay: 193 → **147 s** | | **Intel Arc Pro B70** | Same model, SGLang + the same kernels | Decode, 1 user: **82.6 tok/s**, vs vLLM 75.7 on the same card and day | | **RTX 3090** | Qwen3.8-27B EXL3 3 bpw + MTP | **96.2 tok/s** prose / **141.1** code, 1 user | | **RTX 3090** | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B EXL3 3 bpw + MTP | **251.7 / 357.9 tok/s**, 1 user | | **RTX 3090** | Flash-Next EXL3, 256K context | MTP: 45.5 → **65.6 tok/s** | | **4× H200 NVL** | DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, vLLM + speculative decoding | Crashed under load → **229.1 tok/s** decode, **17,546 tok/s** prefill; all six gates pass | Sources: - [local-ai-registry](https://github.com/sybil-solutions/local-ai-registry): - [Ornith B390 recipe](https://github.com/sybil-solutions/local-ai-registry/tree/main/data/sources/ornith-b390-exl3), with the full hill-climb log in [PR #453](https://github.com/sybil-solutions/local-ai-registry/pull/453) - the RTX 3090 and H200 recipes - [trellis-serve](https://github.com/sybil-solutions/trellis-serve): - `xpu/README.md`, `xpu/docs/PROGRESS.md` and `xpu/docs/SGLANG.md` for B70 - `cuda/README.md` for the RTX 3090 - [qwen-serve](https://github.com/sybil-solutions/qwen-serve) ### Reading the B390 result That run is the one this skill grew out of. Its ceiling calculation said: - **Decode:** 100 tok/s for one user was only reachable with two useful speculative drafts. This model's draft head accepts ~14% at depth 2, so the practical target was ~88–97 tok/s. We reached ~55% of it; the rest is GEMV kernel efficiency. - **Prefill at 256K:** we reached 628 tok/s against a ~670–684 tok/s ceiling. The skill makes the agent compute this up front, so it can tell you early when a target is above the physics. ## How it works ``` ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ measure HW ─▶ │ THEORY.md: bytes/token ÷ bandwidth, FLOPs/token ÷ 50% peak, KV │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │ baseline ─▶ profile ─▶ pick lever (ceiling gap × likelihood) ─▶ configs/NEW.json ▲

description: Hardware ray-traced three.js: a real-time path tracer behind a three.js-style API. Rust + wgpu engine, TypeScript scene and gameplay packages.
readme_excerpt:
ThreeRT

Hardware ray-traced three.js.

A real-time path tracer behind a three.js-style API. Write the scene you would write in three.js,
and every light in it is traced on the GPU's ray-tracing hardware, at 60 fps.

Website · Apps · Download · Docs · Discord · X


ThreeRT, live on an Apple M3 Max: this repository's demos and OpenStrike, a shooter built on the engine.

## Three + RT **Three**, for the API you already know. **RT**, for the three things it adds: - **Ray tracing.** Every light is traced: shadows, bounce light, reflections, and glowing surfaces that light the room. No shadow maps, no light probes, no lightmaps, no baking. - **Real time.** 60 fps in production scenes with the camera moving: Amazon Lumberyard Bistro and Beeple's Zero-Day, on a laptop. Not a still that converges once you stop. - **Runtime.** A game runtime, not only a renderer. Scene code and game logic run inside the engine, and the same file runs as plain three.js in any browser. ## Hello world looks right Write a scene at tutorial size and leave every setting at its default. ```ts import { Scene, PerspectiveCamera, Mesh, BoxGeometry, MeshStandardMaterial, DirectionalLight, SkyAtmosphere } from "@threert/scene"; export default function build() { const scene = new Scene(); const sun = new DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 90000).setSunAngles(28, 100); // lux scene.add(sun); scene.environment = new SkyAtmosphere({ sun }); const plaster = new MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xd9d4cc, roughness: 0.92 }); const wall = new Mesh(new BoxGeometry(6.6, 3, 0.3), plaster); wall.position.set(0, 1.5, -3.15); scene.add(wall); // ... the rest of the room: a floor, a window, a sofa, a lamp const camera = new PerspectiveCamera(58, 16 / 9, 0.05, 200); camera.position.set(-2.3, 1.45, 2.4); camera.lookAt(1.0, 0.9, -1.2); scene.add(camera); return { scene, camera }; } ``` | three.js, as written | ThreeRT, all defaults | |---|---| | ![A room in three.js: flat walls, no sunlight on the floor](site/media/hello/sun-room-three.webp) | ![The same room in ThreeRT: sunlight through the window, bounce light on the walls](site/media/hello/sun-room-rt.webp) | The sun through the window, the sky, the bounce light off the floor and the lamp's glow come from tracing the scene.
